sections.title: 1. Data collected
sections.body: When you place an order or sign up for our newsletter, {siteName} collects information such as your name, email address, delivery address and phone number.

sections.title: 2. Use of data
sections.body: Your data is used to process your orders, contact you about your delivery, and, if you've consented, send you our newsletter. We never sell your data to third parties.

sections.title: 3. Data retention
sections.body: Your data is kept for as long as necessary to manage the business relationship, then archived in accordance with applicable legal obligations.

sections.title: 4. Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct and delete your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us at hello@biofertmaroc.com.

sections.title: 5. Cookies
sections.body: This site uses cookies necessary for it to function properly (cart, preferences) as well as audience-measurement cookies.

sections.title: 6. Contact
sections.body: For any question about this privacy policy, contact us at hello@biofertmaroc.com.
